tools.name: get_health
tools.description: Health check for Teacher presents. Returns ok, storage, paapi, trackingTag (null until enrolled), defaultDomain, catalogCount, and marketplaces[] (domain, label, tagConfigured). Use this first. OpenAPI: getHealth.

tools.name: list_marketplaces
tools.description: List supported Amazon storefronts. Agents MUST pick the user's marketplace and pass it on search/catalog/resolve.

tools.name: search_gifts
tools.description: Search Amazon for teacher appreciation gifts on the user's marketplace. ALWAYS pass marketplace + locale. OpenAPI: searchAmazon.

tools.name: get_catalog
tools.description: Paginated curated teacher gift starters. ALWAYS pass marketplace + locale. Search remains primary discovery. OpenAPI: getCatalog.

tools.name: resolve_product
tools.description: Resolve an ASIN, pasted Amazon /dp/ URL, or keywords to a buyUrl (trackingTag null until enrolled). ALWAYS pass marketplace + locale. OpenAPI: resolveProduct.

tools.name: create_wishlist
tools.description: Create a teacher gift wishlist. Returns id, editToken, ownerUrl, shopUrl, wishlist, storage. Save editToken for add_wishlist_item. OpenAPI: createWishlist.

tools.name: create_and_fill
tools.description: One call: create a curated teacher gifts gift wishlist and return shopUrl (share link) + ownerUrl. Preferred agent path: create a wishlist and add ASINs / keywords / search queries in one call. OpenAPI: agentCreateAndFill.

tools.name: get_wishlist
tools.description: Fetch a wishlist by id. Returns wishlist items with buyUrl/linkType when available, plus ownerUrl and shopUrl. OpenAPI: getWishlist.

tools.name: add_wishlist_item
tools.description: Add an item to a wishlist. Requires editToken from create. OpenAPI: addWishlistItem.
